prose: A report from The Information, per its sources: TypeSafe, the developer of Jev, is in talks to raise more than $1 billion at a valuation above $10 billion, shortly after a previous raise. The body is paywalled and was not captured, so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: another rapid re-rating in AI infrastructure - investors doubling down on developer-tooling companies within weeks of their last round. Jev's product specifics, the investors, and the prior valuation are unknown from the capture.
highlights: TypeSafe, maker of Jev, in talks to raise $1B+ at a $10B+ valuation, per The Information
Comes immediately on the heels of a previous round
Paywalled; product detail, investors and prior valuation unknown
